gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-samarita: Unique from the very first letter, Origami holds each stroke to one thickness, like drawn cable. Noto Sans Samaritan replies with curves full of daylight and a hefty lowercase.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Compass-pencil lines, all one thickness, with a lowercase like poured lead. Origami heads the pair while Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, keeping things modern and clean.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Origami has a single-stroke brush look at constant width, with a lowercase dense as poured lead type. Noto Sans Tagbanwa moves along smoothly, open curves leaving clear gaps between strokes.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Contemporary through and through, Origami draws every stroke without any taper. Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, terminals stopping far from the stem, and that largeness is the pair's standout trait.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-tamil-su: Drawn-cable strokes and a lead-type lowercase make Origami hard to miss. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, with round forms like open parentheses and a tall middle band, gives text a sturdy, stocky feel.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-tc: Origami is all single-stroke brush swagger, with thin joins no thinner than the stems. Noto Sans TC does the quieter work, its curves opening outward instead of curling in, wide counters throughout.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-thai: Origami has stems like dowels and arcs like bent dowels. Noto Sans Thai follows with a swollen, glass-bead lowercase and rounded letters left open, friendly to read at length.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Origami carries diagonals with the same heft as its stems, a brush-like single stroke at constant width. Noto Sans Tirhuta stands out with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-traditional-n: Thin-looking letters that hide no thinner parts make Origami distinctive, all single-stroke brush work at constant width. Noto Traditional Nushu adds broad-nibbed bowls that fill the lines Origami keeps lean.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-numans: Origami writes like a ballpoint, pressure-free and constant, with lowercase dense as lead. Numans loosens everything with tracking pushed well past normal and an s whose ends hang far from the spine.
